decision: Draft only. Resolve repeated Realistic comparison pixel differences and intermittent actual-UI readiness timeout before merge.

qualificationAttemptBudget.rule: AGENTS.md: Stop after three failed attempts on one item and escalate with the evidence.

blockingFindings: Repeated Realistic comparison differences: 21-23 of 480000 pixels; exact visual parity gate fails. Individual comparison pass and canonical caster order did not resolve this.

fullWindows.limitations: SQLite EBUSY/EPERM cleanup and unavailable PDF tools. Hung server.test.ts process explicitly stopped; suite is not a pass. One unchanged-branch SQLite cleanup failure independently reproduced.
